title: 第九章淬炼气血武道入门第十章被拒绝突飞猛进
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
顾晦穿上衣衫，悄无声息地下了床，出了门，绕过屋子来到了后院，站立在黑暗中。
风吹竹林，沙沙作响。
顾晦闭上眼睛，回想着开元炼体术。
推演完善过后，和他身体完美契合能够修炼的开元炼体术已然大变样，和册子上记载的截然不同，若非顾晦亲历这一切的话，只会把它们当成是完全不同的功法。
残缺版有错漏的开元炼体术，一共九个桩功姿势。
前面六个桩功姿势还好，后面三个非常困难，一般人一时间难以练成。
现在，推演过后的开元炼体术，简化成了三个桩功姿势。
这三个桩功姿势非常的简单，和前世不怎么复杂的瑜伽姿势差不多，呼吸吐纳的节奏变化也简化了不少，不像以前那样复杂，稍稍错一点都不成。
顾晦皱了皱眉头。
简化过的功法，貌似谁都能练。
如此简单，能够淬炼出气血？
一次淬体很简单！
只要淬炼出气血，产生了劲，就算是达标，劲和力是两回事，力是散乱的，劲则是凝聚的，更有穿透性，打在人身上，是两种不同的概念。
若是力，一百斤的话，起码四分之三的力量会被缓冲，能有四分之一形成伤害都算是不错了！
劲的话，一百斤起码有**十斤会形成伤害，没有特殊的手段，难以化解。
直到再也淬炼不出气血，劲也不再增长，也就达到了一次淬体大圆满的境界。
父亲顾长青修炼的是错漏的开元炼体术。
他虽然淬炼出了气血，练出了劲，却无法达到大圆满的境界，身体受到了伤害，伤了根源。
如此复杂的修炼功法，还有丹药辅助，结果都这样……
面板推演之后，简化得像广播体操，非常轻易就能够修炼，顾晦难免会怀疑能不能成！

这面板，靠得住？
念头一闪即逝。
顾晦不再拖延，扎下了桩功，开始呼吸吐纳，第一个姿势刚刚摆下，耳边传来了蜜蜂的嗡鸣声。
他抬头看了看面板。
面板弥漫着红光。
面板上，出现了一个和他一模一样的人影，对方和他现在一样，也在扎着桩功。
对方是正确的姿势。
正确的呼吸吐纳。
自己所做的和对方有一些差错。
所以，面板报警！
挺好的！
出现问题竟然有提示！
content_en:
Gu Hui put on his clothes, got out of bed quietly, walked out the door, walked around the house to the backyard, and stood in the darkness.
The wind rustled the bamboo forest.
Gu Hui closed his eyes and thought about the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique.
After the deduction was completed, the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique that perfectly matched his body and could be practiced had completely changed, completely different from what was recorded in the booklet. If Gu Hui had not experienced all this personally, he would have regarded them as completely different techniques.
The incomplete version contains errors and omissions in the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique, with a total of nine postures.
The first six postures of Zhuang Gong are okay, but the last three are very difficult and difficult for ordinary people to master in a short time.
Now, after deduction, the Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique has been simplified into three postures.
These three postures are very simple, similar to the less complicated yoga postures in the previous life. The rhythm changes of breathing and exhalation have also been simplified a lot. They are not as complicated as before, and there is nothing wrong with them.
Gu Hui frowned.
The simplified exercises seem like anyone can practice them.
Is it so simple to temper Qi and blood?
Tempering the body once is very simple!
As long as qi and blood are tempered and strength is produced, it will be considered as reaching the standard. Strength and strength are two different things. Strength is scattered, while strength is condensed and more penetrating. They are two different concepts when they hit people.
If it is force, if it weighs one hundred kilograms, at least three-quarters of the force will be buffered, and a quarter of it causing damage is considered good!
In terms of strength, at least 10% of a hundred pounds will cause damage, which is difficult to resolve without special means.
Until the Qi and blood can no longer be tempered, and the energy no longer increases, it has reached the state of perfect body tempering.
His father, Gu Changqing, practiced the wrong Kaiyuan Body Refining Technique.
Although he had tempered his qi and blood and developed his strength, he was unable to reach the state of Dzogchen. His body was hurt, and his roots were damaged.
Such a complicated practice method, and the aid of elixirs, the results are like this...
After the panel deduction, it was simplified like radio gymnastics, and it was very easy to practice. Gu Hui would inevitably doubt whether it could be done!
Is this panel reliable?
Thoughts are fleeting.
Gu Hui stopped procrastinating, performed the Zhuang Kung Fu, and began to breathe in and out. As soon as he took the first posture, he heard the buzzing of bees in his ears.
He looked up at the panel.
The panel is filled with red light.
On the panel, a figure who looked exactly like him appeared, and the other person was doing the same thing as him now.
The other side is the correct posture.
Correct breathing.
There are some differences between what you do and what the other person does.
So, panel alarm!
fine!
There are prompts when problems arise!
